title: SCIM provisioning provenance & replay playbook for safe deprovisioning and retries
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a provenance and replay-based orchestration layer for SCIM provisioning that guarantees safe deprovisioning and deterministic retry semantics across users and groups. This ticket covers: (1) capturing an append-only provenance log for inbound SCIM events (creates/updates/deprovision), (2) a replay engine to re-run idempotent operations in the correct order during transient failures or tenant migrations, and (3) integrations with audit logs and RBAC v2 to ensure all automated changes are auditable and reversible. The goal is to reduce accidental permanent deprovisions, surface root cause in audit trails, and provide operators with tooling to inspect and replay reconciliation pipelines without manual DB surgery.
acceptance_criteria: Provenance log written for every SCIM event with immutable metadata (event_id, source, received_at, raw_payload)
Replay engine can deterministically reapply events for a tenant or a subset of users/groups and record resulting actions (success/failure) in audit logs
Deprovision actions are gated by a safety policy: soft-delete first, tombstone after configurable TTL unless replay/rollback intervenes
Automated retries respect per-tenant rate limits and exponential backoff; operator-visible retry state appears in Console
Unit and integration tests covering common failure modes (partial network failures, duplicate events, out-of-order delivery) with >=95% deterministic coverage
End-to-end runbook documented and validated in staging with a simulated enterprise IdP (SAML) and sample large group churn
decisions: Use an append-only event store (Kafka or durable DB table w/ monotonic offsets) as the source of truth for SCIM event provenance
Make SCIM actions idempotent by carrying event_id and version tokens; operations must be no-op if already applied
Adopt a two-phase deprovision flow: mark (soft-delete) -> quarantine -> tombstone after TTL; allow replay to unblock quarantine
Record operator-initiated replays and rollbacks as first-class audit entries linked to event_ids
Expose replay controls in Console under tenant admin tools; require RBAC v2 permission 'scim:replay'
comments: 2026-02-20 Maya Patel: Initial write-up. Friction observed in prior incidents: partial deprovisions when SCIM retries arrived out of order. Proposal: event provenance + replay to make recoveries deterministic.

2026-02-25 Ethan Zhang: Spike complete. Validated append-only table with monotonic offsets; prototype replay re-applies events in ordering. Found race when external IdP sends near-duplicate group updates — need stronger idempotency keys on group membership changes.

2026-03-02 SRE Lead (Olivia Rivera): Suggested integrating dead-letter queue for events that fail due to external API rate limits; include automated backoff and operator alerting. Also flagged that audit retention defaults must be configurable per-tenant.

2026-03-05 Design Review (Liam O'Connor): Console UX for replay controls mocked. Recommended clear prompts and a preflight dry-run that shows diffs before applying replay. Also recommended a visibility panel to show which events will be touched and any potential conflicts with RBAC changes.

2026-03-09 Ethan Zhang: Implemented soft-delete + quarantine state in prototype. Added field 'provenance_event_id' to user/group records for traceability. Integration tests added for duplicate events, and replay dry-run implemented.

2026-03-10 Maya Patel: Security review kickoff scheduled. Need to validate that replay operations are logged to audit pipeline with tamper-evident hashes. Next: implement per-tenant replay embargo window and emergency abort flow.
